svg.title: The check of the log of Nextcloud
svg.desc: At its end, run.sh pipes the log of Nextcloud, which holds every record of PHP and of the app at debug, into assert_log.py, which counts the records at each level. A record that the app didn't write and whose message, exception and data name neither a file of the app nor its namespace passes. A record of the app fails the check when it is a deprecation, notice or warning of PHP in a file of the app, an error or a fatal error, or a warning that no test provokes on purpose; every other record of the app passes. Each finding names its place in the files of the app, its request and the record.
